entries.topic: Unqualified Reservations core texts 2007-2014; Land's serial; reception

claims.text: 'A formalist manifesto' by Mencius Moldbug, 2007, 14 pp., held by Princeton; prepared with permission of the author

Formalist Manifesto dated 23 April 2007: 'Violence, then, is anything that breaks the rule, or replaces it with a different rule'; 'Formalism says: let's figure out exactly who has what, now, and give them a little fancy certificate'

Patchwork: A Positive Vision (Part 1), 13 Nov 2008: 'each governed by its own joint-stock corporation without regard to the residents' opinions'; 'If residents don't like their government, they can and should move'; surplus residents: 'Sell their slums out from under them, obviously'; Patchwork 2, 20 Nov 2008
Open Letter chapter 1 'A Horizon Made of Canvas' dated 17 April 2008, opening 'Are you an open-minded progressive?'
Patchwork 2 (2008): 'convert them into biodiesel...'; 'just kidding'; 'Our goal, in short, is a humane alternative to genocide'

Pein, Baffler, 9 Oct 2017: Yarvin's 'Dark Enlightenment dogma is steeped in pseudoscientific racism'; neoreaction 'a subset of what is now euphemistically termed the alt-right'; earlier piece 19 May 2014; Thiel to NYT: 'there's nobody sitting around plotting the future'
Sandifer, Neoreaction a Basilisk, first published 24 June 2016, crowdfunded on Kickstarter; treats Moldbug, Land and Yudkowsky
Scott Alexander's Anti-Reactionary FAQ, 20 Oct 2013, defines neoreaction as 'a political ideology supporting a return to traditional ideas of government and society'

Land serial instalments: Part 1 'Neo-reactionaries head for the exit' 2 Mar 2012; Part 2 'The arc of history is long, but it bends towards zombie apocalypse' 9 Mar; Part 3 19 Mar; Part 4 'Re-running the race to ruin' 1 Apr; 4a 'A multi-part sub-digression into racial terror' 19 Apr; 4b 'Obnoxious observations' 3 May; 4c 'The Cracker Factory' 17 May; 4d 'Odd Marriages' 15 Jun; 4e 'Cross-coded history' 3 Jul; 4f 'Approaching the Bionic Horizon' 20 Jul 2012

Land: the current runs 'From Thomas Hobbes to Hans-Hermann Hoppe'; Moldbug 'supreme Sith Lord of the neoreactionaries'; 'post-demotist society' quote; Land credits Cathedral, neocameralism, Universalism to Moldbug; closes 'It's time to move on'

UR inaugural 2007 post 'A formalist manifesto'; largely stopped updating in 2013 to focus on Urbit; April 2016 announced the blog had 'completed its mission'; first use of 'neoreactionary' 2008; originally 'neocameralism', soon known as 'neoreactionary' (NRx); 2012 BIL talk introducing RAGE ('Retire All Government Employees')

Patchwork Part 1 (13 Nov 2008), on a sovereign corporation's surplus residents: 'Sell their slums out from under them, obviously; demo everything, spray for roaches, rodents, and pit bulls, smooth the rubble out with a bulldozer or two, and possibly a little aerial bombing; erect new residential districts suitable for Russian oligarchs. Next question?'
